Use this exemplar for lawful release-review and redaction workflows outside the monorepo.

1. Fork or clone this repository.
2. Replace public fixture segments with cleared sample content only.
3. Configure the lawful classification taxonomy, release ceiling, residual-risk patterns, and required reviewer roles for your organization.
4. Replace invented review records with cleared approval records that do not expose source text.
5. Update `docs/manuscript/config.yaml`, `domain_profile.yaml`, and `experiment_plan.yaml`.
6. Install the locked dependencies and [run the tests](tests.md) before generating a release report.
7. Run `uv run python scripts/01_generate_release_artifacts.py`; inspect the text-free
   audit and hashed ledger before any separate narrative-publication step.

Never commit real classified, privileged, or source-identifying material to a public fork.


## Refresh the publishing-status block

Set the metadata in [`docs/manuscript/config.yaml`](manuscript/config.yaml).
From the pinned template checkout with the report registered as described
in the [render guide](rendering.md), pass the config explicitly to the
publishing-status tool.

```bash
report_root="$(realpath projects/working/template_redacted_report)"
uv run --no-sync python -m infrastructure.publishing.status_report \
  --project "$report_root" --config "$report_root/docs/manuscript/config.yaml" --write
uv run --no-sync python -m infrastructure.publishing.status_report \
  --project "$report_root" --config "$report_root/docs/manuscript/config.yaml" --check
```
